content: {"episode_id":"ep-05288","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the denial of CPT 93247 on medical necessity grounds, acknowledging that the required prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that persisted despite initial evaluation, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmia. The note indicates long-term continuous ECG monitoring to capture these elusive symptoms and correlate them with cardiac rhythm disturbances."}
